subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` plugin hooks now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but this changes public plugin API names and payload semantics that third-party plugins may rely on across channels.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as public observation-only hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document cross-channel extension expectations.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-owned hook shape now, with explicit follow-up work to avoid permanent cross-channel drift.

options.title: Defer Hook Surface
options.body: Keep reactions as passive system events until maintainers are ready to sponsor the plugin API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as public observation-only hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document cross-channel extension expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The needed decision is primarily on the public plugin hook/context contract, where this person has the strongest recent relevant history.
